text: The annual report records revenue of 4.8 billion dollars for 2025 and reaffirms guidance.
Either party may terminate the services agreement with thirty days written notice.
Customer records are retained for seven years and encrypted at rest using managed keys.
The incident review reports a forty two minute recovery time after the database failover.
The supplier must maintain cyber liability insurance of five million dollars.
The customer may audit supplier security controls once each calendar year with reasonable notice.
Revenue recognition is reviewed during each quarterly accounting close and external audit.
The monitoring service terminated an unhealthy worker after repeated failed health checks.
Operational logs are retained for thirty days before automated deletion.
The insurer reviewed a business interruption claim following a prolonged network outage.
Insurance certificates are audited annually to confirm that coverage remains active.
The independent auditor tested revenue controls and reported no material exceptions.
